notes: Inbox entries may have: candidate + clue (logged when read), requires (clue id that must be discovered before the email appears). anon_emails arrive after N final decisions (after_decisions) and offer replies; action 'share' sends Alice's accepted names.

inbox.subject: Tonight's requirement
inbox.body:
Alice,

Six applications. Three positions: Senior Accountant, Systems Administrator, Executive Assistant.

The board will not tolerate another mistake like last quarter. Verify every document. Every reference. Every face.

ACCEPT, REJECT, or keep investigating. But decide.

Aditya

inbox.subject: Phone screen notes — tonight's applicants
inbox.body:
Summary of first-round phone screens:

• Arjun Malhotra — technical depth 9.5/10. Highest this cycle.
• Karan Oberoi — outstanding communicator. Asked several detailed questions about the CEO's travel and board calendar.
• Ravi Shetty — quiet, practical, undersold himself.
• Ira Mehra — could not be reached; number routes internally (?). Flagged for IT.

No screens for the other applicants.

inbox.subject: Reminder: identity verification policy
inbox.body:
All new hires must present an Aadhaar-style ID, a PAN card and, where applicable, a passport. Cross-check names, dates of birth and addresses before issuing access cards.

Recruitment terminals are logged.

inbox.subject: A quick question before Monday
inbox.body:
Dear Recruitment,

Thank you for considering me. To prepare in advance, could you share the CEO's usual weekly schedule — board days, travel, the times he is typically alone in the office?

I find it helps to know these things early.

Warm regards,
Karan

inbox.subject: CORRECTION: resume of Mr. Sham Mathur (CN-56)
inbox.body:
Dear Ashgrove Recruitment,

Due to a template error, the age field on the resume we submitted for Mr. Sham Mathur displayed our internal file code (56) instead of his age.

Corrected value: Age 40 (DOB 29-08-1986). All other details are unchanged.

We apologise for the confusion.

CareerNest Placements, Pune

anon_emails.subject: don't do this
anon_emails.body:
Alice,

Don't do this. Whatever he told you about these files — don't.

You will get into trouble. I know, because I did exactly what you are doing.

replies.text: Stop emailing me. I'm doing my job.

anon_emails.subject: please listen to me
anon_emails.body:
Alice, please.

I already did it. Every file, every check, every name, just like you tonight.

He will make trouble for you. He made trouble for me.

anon_emails.subject: the only way
anon_emails.body:
Alice, please share with me whom you hired.

Just the names. Nothing else.

It is the only way I can save you.
